📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

How to buy and store fresh cranberries.

According to recent reports, look for firm, glossy cranberries and discard any that are soft, shriveled, or bruised. A few pale pink berries are nothing to worry about.

Keep unwashed cranberries in their original bag in the refrigerator for up to four weeks, though they’re best used sooner. To stock up, freeze them in their original packaging or spread clean thoroughly dried berries on a baking sheet until frozen, then transfer to a freezer bag. They’ll keep their quality for up to a year. Many cooked cranberry recipes work with frozen berries straight from the freezer; check the recipe before thawing.

Industry observers note that that vivid magenta filling is no food-coloring trick: Cranberries and plenty of lime give the curd its electric hue and tang. Let the pie set overnight, then pile on billowy meringue and break out the kitchen torch.

In a recent development, A 12-oz. bag of cranberries, sugar, orange zest, and about 10 minutes at the stove are all you need for this tangy Thanksgiving essential. Make it up to five days ahead and save any leftovers for turkey-cranberry sliders.

Recent findings suggest that layers of tender buttermilk cake, tart cranberry jam, and silky white chocolate frosting make an excellent argument for serving cake on Thanksgiving. The sugared cranberries on top are like little sour candies.

It has been revealed that imagine Key lime pie dressed for the holidays. The punchy cranberry-lime curd meets a crisp press-in crust made with gingersnaps and pecans. A generous dollop of whipped cream rounds out the tartness.

In a recent development, here’s a reason to keep canned cranberry sauce around after Thanksgiving. Jellied sauce melts into a glossy, sweet-and-sour glaze that coats chicken and green beans. Think orange chicken, with a cranberry twist.

Industry observers note that cranberries turn this classic upside-down apple tart a beautiful rosy pink while cutting through its buttery sweetness. Homemade rough puff pastry supplies the flaky base; vanilla ice cream is very much encouraged.

According to recent reports, canned whole-berry cranberry sauce becomes a punchy dressing for pleasantly bitter endive and frisée. Add crunchy candied pecans and salty Manchego, and suddenly cranberry sauce is doing salad duty.

It has been revealed that two layers of buttery, crumbly walnut crust surround a tart cranberry filling in this striking take on a Linzer torte. Save it for a holiday dessert table—or any occasion that calls for something special.

Dress crisp-bottomed Persian rice with dried cranberries, saffron, and fragrant herbs. The berries plump in ghee alongside rosemary, sage, and thyme, adding little pops of sweetness against the savory rice.

Sources indicate that if the wobble is the best part of canned cranberry sauce for you, this homemade version delivers. It’s sliceable, deeply fruity, and subtly fragrant with cardamom and bay leaves. Bring on the ridges.

Recent findings suggest that roasted brussels sprouts get a lively companion in cranberry mostarda, a sweet-tart condiment with mustard seeds, prunes, and a little brandy. Make extra mostarda: It belongs on more than just sprouts.

A warm cranberry-apple topping brings plenty of tart fruit flavor to this crowd-friendly baked oatmeal. It’s a welcome breakfast when the house is full and everyone seems to wake up hungry at once.

Rum, hard cider, cranberry juice, ginger ale, and lime make a lively batch cocktail. Cranberry-studded ice cubes do double duty, keeping glasses cold and making the punch look party-ready.

Sources indicate that jalapeño and lime give classic cranberry sauce a bright, spicy kick. It’s especially good alongside roasted meats or piled onto a leftover turkey sandwich when you want something with a little heat.

It has been revealed that forget the giant roast bird for a minute. These tender, gravy-coated turkey meatballs come with a cranberry-orange marmalade jam that stands in for traditional lingonberries. A heap of mashed potatoes completes the picture.

Sources indicate that fresh ginger gives this cranberry relish some zip, while golden raisins and allspice round out its tartness. Spoon it onto a cheese board or save the leftovers for French toast the next morning.

Herbs in the dredge give this crunchy fried chicken Thanksgiving energy, but the quick cranberry-mustard dipping sauce is the real holiday flourish. It’s a compelling alternative to roasting an entire turkey.

Homemade cranberry-thyme syrup, Campari, and Champagne make a sparkling cocktail that’s fruity, pleasantly bitter, and dressed for a party. Make the syrup up to two weeks ahead; the drinks come together in minutes.

Boxed stuffing mix gets a serious upgrade with aromatic vegetables, dried cranberries, and the savory drippings from crisp-skinned chicken thighs. It’s Thanksgiving-adjacent comfort food, made in one skillet any night of the week.

It has been revealed that roasted sweet potatoes and delicata squash get a glossy, sweet-and-sour cranberry sauce made with red wine vinegar and thyme. Make extra: The agrodolce is just as good spooned over Thanksgiving turkey.

Whole orange and a cinnamon stick give this chunky cranberry sauce its fragrant warmth. Blanching the chopped orange first keeps bitterness in check, while a little butter softens the berries’ sharp edge.

According to recent reports, A buttery, lemony custard studded with tart cranberries gives this Southern classic a holiday spin. The berries stay mostly intact, offering juicy little bursts of tartness against the rich filling.

Recent findings suggest that dried figs bring earthy sweetness to this bold cranberry chutney, while ginger, vinegar, and whole grain mustard keep it lively. It’s the sort of condiment you’ll want beside roast pork as much as turkey.

According to recent reports, dorie Greenspan’s warmly spiced Bundt packs in fresh and dried cranberries, toasted almonds, and a little five-spice powder. Greek yogurt keeps the cake rich; orange icing supplies the finishing flourish.

Baker Amanda Mack tucks a tart cranberry-orange filling into exceptionally flaky buttermilk pastry for individual pies. They’re a thoughtful addition to a dessert spread where everyone wants to try a little of everything.

Industry observers note that no simmering required for this bright, crunchy cranberry relish. Walnuts, shallot, mustard seeds, and Fresno chile give it plenty of texture and bite—a particularly good counterpoint to rich holiday mains.

Industry observers note that homemade cranberry-orange jam gives this tequila cocktail its fruity punch. Lime juice keeps it lively, while a sugar-salt-and-five-spice rim makes each glass taste decidedly more festive than a typical margarita.

Chopped fresh cranberries bring little bursts of tartness to an otherwise classic cheddar grilled cheese. A swipe of Dijon mustard ties the flavors together. Sometimes the best cranberry recipe is also lunch.

It has been revealed that have part of a bag left over? These ideas from the BA archives put even a small quantity to good use.

💡 Key Takeaways
  • Industry observers note that senate Majority Leader John Thune, seen here at the Capitol on Sept.
  • Senate Republicans are preparing to make the transition from the majority to the minority — and their top leaders will seek to retain their positions in the 120th Congress, even after the political drubbing they endured Tuesday night.
  • Majority Leader John Thune, R-S.D., will run for minority leader during next week’s GOP leadership elections, a spokesperson for his office said.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Industry observers note that senate Majority Leader John Thune, seen here at the Capitol on Sept. 15, is hoping to bounce back from Tuesday’s losses and “not stand idly by.” (Tom Williams/CQ Roll Call).

Senate Republicans are preparing to make the transition from the majority to the minority — and their top leaders will seek to retain their positions in the 120th Congress, even after the political drubbing they endured Tuesday night.

Majority Leader John Thune, R-S.D., will run for minority leader during next week’s GOP leadership elections, a spokesperson for his office said.

After enjoying a 53-47 majority, he will face a very different chamber next year, with Democrats looking to control between 54 to 56 seats, depending on how the dust settles.

In a post on X just after midnight on election night, as the extent of the losses became clear, Thune wrote, “Over the last two years, Senate Republicans have put up a strong record of accomplishment that’s created safer streets, more money in Americans’ pockets, and new opportunities for families and businesses to get ahead.”.

Recent findings suggest that “As we head into 2027, Senate Republicans will not stand idly by as the far-left, socialist wing of the Democrat Party attempts to unwind everything we’ve done,” he said. “Thankfully, we still have President Trump in the White House, and we’ll work with him to stop the worst impulses of Democrat extremism.”.

Recent findings suggest that thune, 65, has served as the majority leader for nearly two years since winning a three-way race to succeed Mitch McConnell of Kentucky as the chamber’s top Republican. That was a spot McConnell had held since taking his party’s leadership reins in early 2007, making him the longest-serving Senate party leader in history, counting his time in both the minority and the majority.

Thune at times had a tumultuous relationship with the president as Trump pushed legislation, like the voter-ID related bill known as the SAVE America Act, that never had a chance of passing the chamber.

Senate Majority Whip John Barrasso of Wyoming is expected to seek his current role in the minority as well.

“Republicans had a tough night last night. We lost great Senators in hard races,” he said on X Wednesday afternoon. “There are clear lessons to be learned from the results.”.

“We should listen to what voters unmistakably said last night,” Barrasso, 74, said. “In the Senate, we will aggressively oppose terrible ideas that drive our country toward the socialism Democrats embraced. Our commitment is to common sense. And our focus should not waiver from the top priority of driving down prices that have remained stubbornly too high.”.

“I’m here for the fight,” he added.

Recent findings suggest that the leadership elections for Senate Republicans will take place on Tuesday, Nov. 10, at 9 a.m. in the Old Senate Chamber.

So far, no one has publicly come forward to challenge Thune, and his fellow Republican colleagues were already coalescing around him ahead of the midterms.

Florida Sen. Rick Scott, who ran against Thune in 2024 and is a friend of the president’s, said in September then he was not planning on challenging him again.

Recent findings suggest that sen. James Lankford, R-Okla., is expected to seek a repeat as vice chair of the Republican conference, while Sen. Shelley Moore Capito, R-W.V., is set to run again for Republican Policy Committee chair, according to people familiar with their aims.
